title: Public property discovery
objective: Open {{base_url}}. Click 'Explore properties' in the top navigation and verify the heading 'Find your place.' is visible and the result count shows 'PROPERTIES'. Click the 'Buy' tab in the listing toolbar and verify at least one property card with a price in Naira (₦) is shown. Click 'View details' on the first card and verify a dialog opens showing a disclaimer that tells the visitor to independently confirm documents or not to send money.

title: Register a new buyer account
objective: Open {{base_url}}/auth?mode=register. Create an account with full name 'Kane Buyer', email {{smart.random_email}}, password {{kane_password}} and the role 'Buyer or renter'. Submit the form and verify the dashboard greeting 'Hello, Kane.' is visible and the role badge shows 'buyer'.

title: Login, protected routes and logout
objective: Open {{base_url}}/app and verify the sign-in form titled 'Welcome back' is visible. In that form enter email {{buyer_email}} and password {{buyer_password}} and click 'Sign in'. Verify a greeting that starts with 'Hello' is visible on the dashboard. Reload the page and verify the greeting that starts with 'Hello' is still visible. Click 'Sign out' and verify the home page heading 'Find a place.' is visible.

title: Landlord creates a draft and cannot submit without evidence
objective: Open {{base_url}}/auth and sign in with email {{landlord_email}} and password {{landlord_password}}. Open 'My listings' and click 'New listing'. Fill the form with title 'Kane test flat in Gwarinpa', listing type Rent, price 4500000, 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, address '12 Test Close, Gwarinpa', city 'Abuja', state 'FCT' and a description of at least 30 characters, then click 'Create draft'. Verify the page heading 'Edit listing.' and a 'Draft' badge are visible. Click 'Submit for review' without uploading anything and verify an error says a photograph or ownership document is required before submitting.

title: Listing form rejects invalid input
objective: Open {{base_url}}/auth and sign in with email {{landlord_email}} and password {{landlord_password}}. Open {{base_url}}/app/listings/new, leave every field empty and click 'Create draft'. Verify validation messages appear for the title, price, address, city and description fields, and that no 'Edit listing.' heading appears.

title: Verifier queue and decision rules
objective: Open {{base_url}}/auth and sign in with email {{verifier_email}} and password {{verifier_password}}. Open 'Verification queue'. If the text 'The queue is clear' is shown, verify that message. Otherwise click the first listing, verify the buttons 'Approve and verify' and 'Reject' are visible, leave the notes empty, click 'Reject' and verify a message asks for the reason for rejection.

title: Buyer sidebar and review page are restricted
objective: Open {{base_url}}/auth and sign in with email {{buyer_email}} and password {{buyer_password}}. Verify the sidebar shows 'Overview' and 'Saved' but does not contain 'My listings', 'Verification queue' or 'Admin'. Open {{base_url}}/app/review and verify the page says 'You do not have access to this page'.

title: Landlord permissions are enforced
objective: Open {{base_url}}/auth and sign in with email {{landlord_email}} and password {{landlord_password}}. Verify the sidebar contains 'My listings' but does not contain 'Verification queue' or 'Admin'. Open {{base_url}}/app/review and verify the page says 'You do not have access to this page'.

title: Sample listings cannot receive inspections or reports
objective: Open {{base_url}}, click 'Explore properties', click 'View details' on the first property card and verify the dialog is visible. Verify the dialog tells the visitor that inspection requests are only available for live verified listings, or that this is a sample listing, and that no date picker for an inspection is shown.

title: Admin console shows users and audit log
objective: Open {{base_url}}/auth and sign in with email {{admin_email}} and password {{admin_password}}. Open 'Admin' in the sidebar and verify a Users table and an Audit log section are visible. Verify the role selector in the row marked '(you)' is disabled. Open 'Reports' and verify the heading 'Suspicious reports.' is visible.

title: Buyer cannot open admin or new-listing pages
objective: Open {{base_url}}/auth and sign in with email {{buyer_email}} and password {{buyer_password}}. Open {{base_url}}/app/admin and verify the page says 'You do not have access to this page'. Open {{base_url}}/app/listings/new and verify the page says 'You do not have access to this page'.

title: How it works section and documentation page
objective: Open {{base_url}}. Scroll to the section titled 'How it works' and verify the heading 'From a listing to a decision you can follow.' and the text 'What verified does and does not mean' are visible. Click 'Read the documentation' and verify the page heading 'How GidaLink Trust earns trust.' is visible, then click 'Roles and permissions' in the side list and verify the text 'Verifier and admin accounts are created by the GidaLink team' is visible.
